description: This file defines utilities for parcelable objects in Android's NDK, including the AParcelableHolder class for managing parcelable data with stability considerations.

classes.name: AParcelableHolder
classes.description: A class for holding and parceling parcelable objects with stability management, introduced in Android API level 31.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes the holder's parcel data into a parcel.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Deserializes parcel data into the holder, verifying stability.

methods.name: setParcelable
methods.description: Sets a parcelable object into the holder.

methods.name: getParcelable
methods.description: Retrieves a parcelable object from the holder.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the parcel data in the holder.
